page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column, with a circular diagram with Greek letter labels in the middle; no margin notes. Catchword "Ter" at lower right. The diagram is not text.

main_text.p: tes seu circundata repagula attingat, Collabitur ergo donec ad ϛ γ limites usq; attollitur, At limites β γ æquabit, ubi conuexum ϛ ε γ attigerit, quod situ & altitudine limitibus ϛ γ respondet. Totam ergo cauitatem ϛ ε γ usq; ad ε conuexum explebit, ideoq; cum terra unam conficiet & conformabit superficiem, quod erat demonstrandum.

Ex his manifestum est, primo nihil interesse inter centrum grauitatis, et centrum magnitudinis. Sed unum esse centrum amborū elementorum coeuntium in unum globum, et tendentium ad unum idemq; centrum grauitatis. Terra enim cum sit grauior, aperitur ac dehiscit, & aquas recipit.
Secundo, locum aquæ quæ terram operire & totam tegere debebat, mutatum esse propter animantia. Ter

page.notes: Diagram: circle with centre labelled ϛ (or similar Greek), points β, γ, ε on the circumference, a vertical line from ε through the centre and a horizontal chord β–γ, with lines joining the centre to β and γ. Labels are Greek letters and are not transcribed as text. Some letters in the diagram are uncertain.
